checks.finding: RESULT_UNVERIFIED.json is published create-only before result identity and post-call input/source checks; a subsequent failure preserves that result and its hash in FAILED.json without acceptance.

Completion checks bind request bytes, canonical case identity, result bytes, provisional-result equality, receipt seal and requested/enclosed prefix. Corrupt terminal data blocks even explicit retry; failed/interrupted/noncertified attempts require explicit distinct retries.

Executing runner, source lock, local modules, external PHYS76 transport and immutable HH74 resources are pinned; runtime is recorded and rechecked before and after calls. Engine entry remains cell_enclosure.certify_request only.
Manifest directory is prepended only for engine import; foreign already-loaded pinned modules and unpinned local Python modules are rejected. Final tests reside outside the source root.

No uncoordinated fallback. PID liveness precedes pool construction, acquisition precedes child startup, worker PID/start-tick handoff precedes the engine gate, and the gate remains strongly referenced until child exit. The normal path joins each worker before own lease release.

No kill/terminate/signals to peers or overdue own workers. Dispatch horizon stops new launches only. Abrupt external dispatcher termination can leave STARTED-only checkpoints or dead leases for later protocol pruning; active worker evidence and leases are not falsely marked completed.

unit/source/run_enclosures.py and unit/tests/test_run_enclosures.py are byte-identical to the frozen tested files. With unit under research/, HH74 resources and sibling PHYS76 transport resolve correctly.

The runner scans every request-directory JSON. Final unit/inputs/pending_ncp contains exactly the three request JSON files; original manifest and preparation receipt are byte-identically preserved separately in evidence.

integration_receipts.interpretation: Root local read-only preflight only; no NCP execution or handoff claim. Earlier PID-unobservable observation remains historical.

limitations: Advisory leases and sampled availability are not kernel CPU/RSS reservations.
A common host/shared path/PID namespace remains an operational precondition.
The 17 existing tests use fake workers and synthetic resource observations; actual NCP handoff remains unexecuted.
review_scope: Read-only source and existing receipts; no runner, engine, RHS, ODE or test execution
